707 reviews. 4.8 stars. For a bánh mì spot in Cửa Lấp.

Bánh Mì & You is not the big tourist strip. It's the kind of place where the bread is still warm, the line moves fast, and locals outnumber tourists 3 to 1.

Budget $15-30 a head and you're eating well. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
